title: Decision Schema
description: A decision is an authority's judgment on a claim

review_authority.description: ID of the authority making the decision

claim_id.description: ID of the claim being decided

accepted_claims.description: Claim IDs accepted as part of this decision

rejected_claims.description: Claim IDs rejected as part of this decision

decided_at.description: Timestamp when the decision was made

valid_until.description: Optional timestamp when the decision expires

conditions.description: Conditions that must hold for this decision to remain valid

obligations.description: Obligation IDs created by this decision

authority_delegation.description: If this decision delegates authority to another entity
